entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: The matter's been settled. You'll be[n]welcomed into his household.

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: You won't officially be registered yet,[n]but isn't that how things are with young[n]people these days?

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: Go prove your sincerity to him.[n]You can do that, can't you?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: So, I'm not even allowed to decide where[n]I will live, am I?

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: Not only do you come home late, you've[n]even stayed out overnight without[n]permission...

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: I thought I had been clear about[n]the friends you choose.

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: I have my hands full right now with the[n]company. Don't cause any more trouble[n]for me.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...I need to discuss something with[n]everyone. Can we all meet?
